editorial: We visited in early June. Istanbul was hot but manageable and the crowds had not yet reached full summer madness.
For the version of this itinerary we'd choose again, late spring or early autumn strikes the best balance: long days, tolerable heat and fewer people than peak July-August.
Cappadocia adds another variable because balloon flights are weather-dependent. Whatever month you choose, a second morning there is worth more than obsessing over the statistically perfect date.
